output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # separator color is the most frequent nonzero value
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x!=0)
    sep=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    obj=[x for x in cnt if x!=sep]
    if not obj:return h
    oc=obj[0]
    starts_r=[i for i in range(H) if all(grid[i][j]==sep for j in range(W))]
    starts_c=[j for j in range(W) if all(grid[i][j]==sep for i in range(H))]
    rs=[0]+[i+1 for i in starts_r]
    cs=[0]+[j+1 for j in starts_c]
    rs=[x for x in rs if x<H]; cs=[x for x in cs if x<W]
    masks=[]
    for a in rs:
      for b in cs:
        masks += [[(r-a,c-b) for r in range(a,min(a+5,H)) for c in range(b,min(b+5,W)) if grid[r][c]==oc]]
    for a in rs:
      for b in cs:
        for mask in masks:
          for dr,dc in mask:
            r,c=a+dr,b+dc
            if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and h[r][c]==0:h[r][c]=sep
    return h"}
